## Orientation

Work in `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/milestone-nav` only. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call adaptive-artifacts. Primary checkout owns the store.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R3: Phases with no milestone appear in an Ungrouped group after all milestone groups.
R7: A milestone whose state is done starts collapsed; the user can expand and collapse it.
R8: The milestone that contains the currently selected phase (or the default phase when following) starts expanded.

## Approach

Add `MilestoneRow` to `types.ts` and type `EffortView.milestones` as `MilestoneRow[]`. Add pure helpers `groupPhasesByMilestone(effort)` and `initialExpandedMilestones(effort, phaseSubject)` in `efforts.ts` or a small `milestones.ts`. Cover with vitest fixtures: grouping order, Ungrouped last, done milestones omitted from the initial expand set, current/default phase milestone included.


### Requirements (quote by id)

R3: Phases with no milestone appear in an Ungrouped group after all milestone groups.
R7: A milestone whose state is done starts collapsed; the user can expand and collapse it.
R8: The milestone that contains the currently selected phase (or the default phase when following) starts expanded.

### Design / decisions (quote)

#### Invariants
- When milestones exist, the flat stepper is not shown for that effort.
- Task scoping still goes through `resolvedPhase` / `filteredTasks`.
- Expand/collapse never changes the selected phase by itself.

#### Assumptions
- Spike `phaseSection` in `spikes/web-dashboard/static/app.js` is the visual reference, not a runtime dependency.
- Milestone `state` values match `dashboard.model._milestone_state` (including `done`).

- milestone-nav-layout: Port the spike Phases block: milestone headers with phase rows; flat stepper only when there are no milestones
- milestone-nav-collapse: Finished milestones collapsed by default; milestone containing the selected or default phase stays expanded
- milestone-nav-web-only: Implement milestone grouping only in dashboard/web/ui; Textual unchanged
